title: Durable Main uptime and promotion guard

replayContract.intent: Keep T3 Code Main continuously supervised on giggabit-server, preserve and reverse unauthorized checkout mutations, and publish a candidate only after strict exact-SHA public project-and-chat proof.
preserve: Keep Main boot-managed and restart-supervised through the user systemd manager.
Keep the approved SHA fail-closed outside a short exact-candidate promotion lock.
Preserve dirty files, conflict stages, refs, and committed divergence before automatic restoration.
Require a fresh canonical Main primary-interface project/chat proof receipt from the same promotion window before approval.
Keep GitHub Main and the Mac checkout unchanged until the live Linux candidate is approved.
safeAutoRepair: Adapt unit templates, launcher paths, ports, and verifier integration to unambiguous upstream script or package refactors.
Adapt incident capture commands while retaining equivalent full Git and worktree evidence before restoration.
Adapt the Main verifier to upstream project-list, composer, or assistant-response selectors while preserving the complete public workflow.
Update promotion skill wording and commands to match equivalent renamed service or verifier interfaces.
stopForHuman: Stop if upstream changes the Main runtime ownership model, durable worktree topology, or user-systemd boot assumptions enough to require a new operating decision.
Stop if preserving the feature would weaken exact-SHA enforcement, evidence capture, automatic rollback, or strict public proof.
Stop if the canonical Main verifier can no longer create a real project chat and receive a provider response without changing the acceptance contract.
Stop if a repair would authorize direct product work in the live Main checkout.
